latestVersion.changelog:
AI Image to Video — initial release

- Convert JPG, PNG, WEBP, and HEIC images (up to 200MB) into 1080p MP4 videos using a cloud GPU pipeline.
- Automatic backend setup, including free authentication (100 credits, 7 days).
- Simple user actions: upload images, describe your video, export, check credits, and preview timeline.
- Session keeps track of workflow; supports editing, adding tracks (audio/text), and quick exports.
- Error handling for file type, size, credits, and authentication.
- Multiple export options: mp4, mov, avi, webm, mkv, jpg, png, gif, webp, mp3, wav, m4a, aac.
